messages:
Eve L: Quick end-of-week 1 check-in — what I did / blockers / today:
- Done: laptop imaged, joined org, pulled most repos, set up SSH key, joined Slack, attended infra intro.
- Blockers: can't pull private Docker image (401), GCP service account still pending, KMS decryption permission denied for local secrets, office wifi drops when VPN is active.
- Today: follow up with infra for SA/KMS, finish small onboarding README PR, pair with Jamie on model-registry demo at 3pm PT.

Oliver C: Welcome! I'll escalate the GCP SA and KMS. Can you paste the exact docker pull error?

Eve L: docker pull gcr.io/redwood-inference/private/onboarding:latest -> "unauthorized: authentication required". Ran `gcloud auth configure-docker` and it reported no credential helper set for gcr.io.

Jamie M: I can pair at 3pm PT. Quick check — did you add your public SSH key to the IDP? If not: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"eve@example.com\"` then `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and paste `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` into the IDP.

Provision Bot: ⏳ Provision request [2065432100] created for gcp-sa-eve@redwood-inference — ETA ~4h.

InfraOps: KMS access requires SRE approval for new keys. @Oliver C can approve? Temporarily gave eve kube-reader until EOD for onboarding tasks.

Oliver C: Approved KMS request. Infra also added your email to the docker registry ACL; try the pull again. :thumbsup:

Eve L: Tried again — docker pull succeeded, thanks! KMS decryption still failing with `AccessDeniedException` when running local secrets decrypt.

InfraOps: That sounds like a missing cryptokey decrypter binding. Try: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/onboarding/cryptoKeys/secret --member=user:eve@example.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` — I'll check audit logs and send a trace.

Eve L: Will try that now. Also pinging on PR: small edits to onboarding README, PR: https://git.redwood/s/newhi/onboard-readme/pull/42 — @Jamie M can you review when you have a sec?

Jamie M: Reviewing now, will leave comments inline and merge any non-controversial bits.

Eve L: One more — office wifi drops whenever corp-vpn is connected. Anyone else hit this? @Oliver C

Oliver C: Known issue with the new firewall rules; filed INF-879. Workaround: enable split-tunnel or use mobile hotspot until SRE deploys fix. I'll DM steps for split-tunnel.

Eve L: Thanks all — most urgent items unblocked (docker), will follow up on KMS and finish PR before pairing.
